scientific_integrity: The sharp upper bound and resulting identity are proved here; the lower-bound construction is explicitly attributed to Abboud and Yaakobi. The length-eight binary distance-three seed, its size, and classical upper bound are attributed to established code-table literature. No independent external validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: One total edit only; formula refers to the classical maximum \(A_2(\ell,3)\), which is not explicitly known at every \(\ell\); source paper assumes n>ell. Non-power-of-two size does not imply an improvement in fixed-length binary message-bit redundancy.
title: Exact one-edit capacity of the binary sum channel
